**Forum-handle field in the Digital Minds publish**
Drop the LW/AF half deliberately; note it on the surviving row and revisit with the portfolio-field decision after Digital Minds fill data.

The signal has no advocate and no consumer: Jaime's 2026-07-30 comments name GitHub signals only, even the GitHub half's screening value is itself an unproven blocked_by split-off, and no code consumes forum karma. Forum handles are pseudonymous, so a field is the only route — but the runbook already recorded 'GitHub-only, revisit after fill-rate data', and reopening a settled 5-change bundle (Jaime message drafted, Kamil briefed) 7 days before Aug 14 adds joint length risk for the lowest-expected-fill field. Cost of wrong: one cohort's handles, recoverable at the Sept 4 hackathon. If you disagree on signal value, the cheap add is one optional forum-URL field + Notion property + Zap mapping (~30 min, no lambda leg) — then name it in the split-off test so it has a consumer.


**Signup publish capture-only vs GitHub-to-People DoD**
